title: Add a ui-quality rule that flags native select dropdowns
notes: Owner 2026-11-25: codeality-ui should flag native system dropdowns; in compratuentrada every dropdown must be a custom searchable one, and the same happens in other projects.
ui-quality has no warning severity since 2026-10-11 (error or nothing), so this is an error rule, likely opt-in or configurable per project.
done_when: A page rendering a native <select> fails ui-quality in a project that enables the rule, with a fixture test.
